title: holy sh*t spaceX
speaker: Kevin Paffrath (Meet Kevin)

macro_themes.view: Highly likely to happen and be approved by Tesla shareholders, probably at a Tesla premium.
SpaceX superintelligence compute revenue ~3x plus large deferred revenue; spending boom good for Nvidia and tech.

calls.reason: Strong quarter: compute revenue ~3x, deferred revenue up to $4.9B, guide above estimates; trades ~1 PEG; has not sold a share and bought more.
calls.quote: I've been a little bullish on SpaceX. Haven't sold a single share of it. And you know, we bought some more of it.

calls.reason: SpaceX compute build-out ("the suck") benefits Nvidia, its exclusive space partner.
calls.quote: the suck is going to continue, and boy is it good for Nvidia.

notes: Date from "October 9th, so just about 11 days ago" -> 2026-10-20. SpaceX ticker not stated; used SPACEX placeholder. 132 is the floor he cited in an Oct 9 email. Tesla called ~5 PEG, "probably twice what it's worth" but no trade bias stated; not recorded.
